literal: That which was intended to attain is easy indeed, if one is able to keep in mind that very thing which was intended.
translation: It is easy to attain what one has planned, if one can keep that very plan constantly in mind without forgetfulness.
modern: நினைத்ததை அடைவது மிகவும் எளிது, நினைத்த காரியத்தையே எப்போதும் மறவாமல் நினைவில் வைத்திருக்க முடிந்தால்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the power of constant focus and mindfulness in achieving success. The poet asserts that achieving a goal is highly feasible, provided one does not lose sight of the initial intention. The repetition of the word 'உள்ளியது' (that which was thought) emphasizes that the key to success lies in keeping the original objective continuously in one's thoughts. By avoiding forgetfulness and maintaining unwavering attention, any intended outcome becomes easily attainable.
